headline: Md Boktiar Mahbub Murad surges into ARC-3 gold places

sections.text: Md Boktiar Mahbub Murad jumped from 363rd to 18th, gaining 6.83 points to reach 36.89 and move into the 18 gold places.
That puts the newcomer at the edge of the public gold band as the race tightens near its cutoff.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
